title: Monthly Recurring event on 29th February in case of non leap year.
body:
### Issue Description:-
I recently encountered an issue with the monthly recurring event feature in your calendar app. When creating a monthly recurring event on 29th, the app doesn't handle February correctly, as it only has 28 days or 29 in leap year. App allows to creates an event on 29th February if you are creating an event in Leap year.

### Expected Behavior:-
For monthly recurring events on 29th February in non leap year the app should ask user before creating an event that “You are creating an event for 29th and there will be no event for said date in February in non leap years (since it doesn't have 29th) so the event will get adjusted to the last day of February i.e. 28th or skip the event for those non leap years”.

### Actual Behavior
The app currently doesn't provide a suitable option for handling February 29th event in non leap years, leading to missing the event in non leap years and defeats the purpose of scheduling events and creating reminders.

### Suggested Improvement
Please consider adding a feature to handle month-end dates for recurring events, ensuring that February is correctly accounted for in non leap years for 29th dated event.

Thank you for considering this feedback! I look forward to seeing improvements in future updates.
